sessions.title: From Vibe to Code: Prototyping with Google AI Studio & Antigravity
sessions.summary: Toby Knight (Head of Customer Engineering UK/IE) and Fabian Desnoes (Customer Engineer – Startups) walk through building production applications using Google AI Studio for rapid prototyping and Antigravity for cloud-native deployment — from vibe to code in one session.
highlights: Elephant & Goldfish mental model for agent memory
50% quota discount on Gemini 3.7/3.8 Flash
Gemini 4 Argon — new frontier class model
Startup credits usable inside Antigravity
Model Armor + SDP for GDPR health data

sessions.title: Build Multi-Agent Systems with the Agent Development Kit (ADK)
sessions.summary: Deep dive into Google's Agent Development Kit — from single-agent prompts to complex multi-agent topologies with SequentialAgent, LoopAgent, ParallelAgent, and hierarchical patterns. Covers A2A protocol, Model Armor, and production deployment patterns.
highlights: 4 ADK topology patterns with production-ready code
LongRunningFunctionTool + SessionService for async execution
Time-travel branching for eval reproducibility
Hard token budgets via GCP spend caps + Agent Gateway limits
Burst deduplication via pixel/embedding caching
A2A: direct message passing, not shared graph context

sessions.title: Scale with Confidence: Deploying Serverless AI on Google Cloud
sessions.summary: Zack Akil (Full-Stack ML Engineer) demonstrates building and deploying a serverless document processing pipeline using Antigravity. Covers GCS → Pub/Sub → Cloud Run → BigQuery with Gemini on Vertex AI for document intelligence.
highlights: Antigravity /grill-me: 8 structured architectural review questions
GCS → Pub/Sub → Cloud Run → BigQuery serverless pipeline
Flask + Gunicorn on Cloud Run with auto-generated deploy scripts
Extension: real Gemini OCR, DLQ, Secret Manager, Eventarc
Walkthrough artifact with pytest verification (11/11 pass)

sessions.title: Decoding VC Math: Is Your AI Startup Built for Venture Scale?
sessions.summary: Adam French (Partner at Antler UK, co-founder of Scalable Capital) decodes early-stage venture math, unit economics under inference token costs, the Five Lenses framework for category creation, pre-seed defensibility hierarchy, and evaluation criteria for the London Phase 2 In-Person Summit.
highlights: The Five Lenses to Make an Idea Bigger: 10x More Places, Replace Legacy, Market Standard, 10x More Differentiated, Beat Competition
Inference Gross Margin Guardrail: targeting >= 75% gross margins for agentic SaaS workflows; avoid un-cached frontier loops
Pre-seed defensibility hierarchy: Customer Distribution > Proprietary Domain Data > Regulatory/Statutory Moats > Agent Orchestration > Prompt Wrappers
Solo-founder underwriting: Antler backs solo technical founders in exceptional cases where asymmetric execution velocity out-ships traditional 10-person teams
Mispriced markets & wedge strategy: targeting hidden operational labor pools rather than fighting over defended enterprise software line items
London Phase 2 In-Person Summit: evaluated on 4-week shipping velocity (40%), venture scale (25%), unit economics (20%), and peer engagement (15%)

concepts.title: The Elephant & Goldfish Mental Model
concepts.summary: Elephant = long-term document store (single source of truth spec). Goldfish = context window (current working memory). Architecture pattern for keeping agent context manageable while maintaining grounded anchors.

concepts.title: SequentialAgent Pattern
concepts.summary: Deterministic linear pipeline: sub-agents execute in strict list order passing shared InvocationContext. Ideal for SDLC: spec → code → test → review.

concepts.title: LoopAgent Pattern
concepts.summary: Iterative refinement with max_iterations and tool-based escalation. Sub-agents cycle until exit_loop is invoked or max_iterations reached.

concepts.title: ParallelAgent Pattern
concepts.summary: Concurrent fan-out: run_async across independent research branches, downstream merger agent reads from session.state.

concepts.title: Antigravity /grill-me Architectural Review
concepts.summary: 8 structured follow-up questions covering security, processing logic, schema provisioning, failure handling, framework choice, IaC preference, and local testing before any code is generated.

concepts.title: GCS → Pub/Sub → Cloud Run → BigQuery Pipeline
concepts.summary: Canonical serverless event-driven pattern: GCS OBJECT_FINALIZE triggers Pub/Sub push to Cloud Run (Flask+Gunicorn), processor uses Gemini on Vertex AI, streams metadata to BigQuery.

concepts.title: Five Lenses to Make an Idea Bigger
concepts.summary: Antler's VC framework: 10x more places, replace legacy, market standard, 10x more differentiated, beat competition. Used to evaluate whether a startup idea has venture-scale potential.
